name: lif
title: LIF
inputs: Leica LIF files (LAS X and LAS AF, versions 1 and 2), and its object files (LOF) and extension files (LIFEXT): every image of the file's element tree, with interleaved or planar channels, z-stacks, time series and mosaics, uncompressed
for: Leica LIF, LOF and LIFEXT files (`.lif`, `.lof`, `.lifext`)
